title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-15
ranking_explanation: Sorted the 12 visible repositories by the stars-today values shown on GitHub Trending, descending. The gains are the matching daily Trending figures, not independently computed deltas. Repository metadata and current default-branch commit SHAs were checked via GitHub REST; GitHub Search API exact-name queries corroborated the five leading repositories.
global_caveat: Trending values, star totals, and repository metadata are live snapshots and can change. This is a daily snapshot taken at 17:42 UTC; commit SHAs and star totals were checked shortly afterward. No prior-window comparison was collected.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily GitHub Trending snapshot captured 2026-11-15 17:42 UTC; date range 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-15. Ranked by displayed daily star gains.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is the build-out of practical tooling around coding agents: browser guidance, office apps, review surfaces, and agent-integrated developer tools lead the daily star gains. Google Chrome's modern-web guidance tops the gain list, while Univer and Plannotator show strong demand for agent-ready application experiences and human review.

sections.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
sections.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
sections.why_notable: It leads today's observed star gains and turns browser expertise into searchable, retrievable agent context, including legacy-pattern scans.

sections.title: dream-num/univer
sections.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain; its SDK approach makes office editing and calculation capabilities composable inside applications and agents.

sections.title: backnotprop/plannotator
sections.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
sections.why_notable: Third-highest gain, reflecting demand for human-in-the-loop review across multiple coding agents and version-control workflows.

sections.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
sections.why_notable: A high-gain project that gives agents access to browser debugging, network inspection, automation, and performance traces.

sections.title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
sections.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
sections.why_notable: One of the day's fastest risers outside the core coding-tool cluster, illustrating domain-specific agent skill packaging.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
sections.why_notable: The repository pairs substantial daily traction with a production-oriented hybrid review design and multi-language rule coverage.

sections.title: Tencent/LoopForge
sections.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
sections.why_notable: It represents the operations side of agent adoption: controlled delivery pipelines rather than just code generation.

sections.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
sections.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
sections.why_notable: Its protocol and middleware aim to standardize streaming, state synchronization, and human interaction across agent frontends.

sections.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
sections.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
sections.why_notable: It adds to the visible pattern of distributing specialized design and product workflows as portable agent skills.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
sections.why_notable: Security-oriented skills are gaining alongside general coding-agent integrations, with a broad catalog of vulnerability workflows.

sections.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
sections.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
sections.why_notable: It addresses the evaluation layer needed to tell whether agent skill packages are useful and distinct, rather than merely numerous.

sections.title: ggml-org/ggml
sections.why_notable: The smallest gain among these entries, but a useful infrastructure counterpoint to the agent-facing application and workflow tools.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent context and skill distribution: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src, google-labs-code/stitch-skills, tradermonty/claude-trading-skills, elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter, and NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator show both the spread of skills and a growing need to evaluate them. Human-in-the-loop interfaces and delivery: backnotprop/plannotator, ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui, and Tencent/LoopForge emphasize reviewing, interacting with, and approving agent work. Agent-integrated developer tools: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp and alibaba/open-code-review connect agents to browser inspection and code review; ggml-org/ggml is a lower-gain ML infrastructure signal. AI-enabled application building: dream-num/univer brings office editing, calculation, and collaboration into embeddable product components. Languages: TypeScript 6, Python 3, Go 2, C++ 1.

themes.name: Security and evaluation for agent skills

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The daily list points to a shift from agent capability demos toward practical systems: agents need current domain context, reliable tools, user-facing interaction, review gates, and measurable quality. TypeScript-heavy frontend and workflow projects dominate the list, while code review and security show that trust and control are becoming core parts of the agent developer stack.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured 2026-11-15 17:42 UTC. GitHub REST repository and branch-commit endpoints checked metadata and default-branch SHAs for all listed repositories; GitHub Search API search/repositories confirmed exact-name matches and current indexed metadata for five leading repositories. Daily gains and displayed totals are from the matching GitHub Trending view, ranked by displayed gains. No prior-window comparison was used.
